flags.summary: Izek Strazni has taken to standing at night outside the place where Ireena shelters in Vallaki, staring at her window (the first stage of the ally visit izek_takes_ireena, data/visits/izek.json). It is what lets the second stage, the taking, come two days later (Story Allies Presence Plan, package Z1).
Izek carried Ireena off from her refuge in Vallaki to his room in the Baron's mansion (the visit's second stage). Set once and never cleared, so he takes her only once, however it ends.

Ireena is in Izek's room at the Baron's mansion now. She counts as held only while Izek lives and has not been told the truth (izek_dead, izek_told_truth) and she does not travel with the party: the inn and the church do not place her, nor Ismark, and Strahd's three visits to her skip her, for exactly as long. Cleared when the party frees her, when she is freed in the room's fight, or when she gets out alone.

How the taking ended: rescued (the party walked her out by day), threatened (Izek let her go under a threat), truth (he was told she is his sister), fought (the party fought him; she left before the fight) or escaped (two days passed and she got out alone, broke his nose with a candlestick in front of the watch and came back colder: it costs her trust, ireena_trust -= 2, and his pride). Empty if Izek died or was told the truth somewhere else while she was held. Read by Izek's room afterwards (narrative/allies/izek_takes:after_hold); later Ireena and Izek packages and the epilogues may read it.
The party has found Ireena in Izek's room (narrative/allies/izek_takes), by night with Izek there or by day without him. It picks the first sight over the shorter return.

The party heard Emil's account of the night Izek lost his sister: a boy screaming, a girl with red hair, a rider in black at the treeline, and wolves that were the castle's, not the pack's (werewolf_den/emil:lake_night). It lets the party tell Izek (allies/izek:tell_rider). Story Allies Presence Plan, package Z2; no story reads it.
The party told Izek what Emil saw (allies/izek:tell_rider): the wolves were the castle's and a rider in black stood at the treeline. It opens his talk about the castle; no story reads it.

The game minute the party first found Izek digging in the woods past Lake Zarovich (allies/izek:woods), once he had been told the truth. He stays there a day, then stands at Kolyan's grave in the village of Barovia (days_since.izek_woods_met).
The party has met Izek at Kolyan's grave in the village of Barovia (allies/izek:grave). It picks his first words from his later ones.

Izek sits guard at Ireena's door wherever she shelters (the Blue Water Inn, St. Andral's, the Krezkovs' house, her father's mansion), or follows her once she travels with the party: the party asked him to at the grave (allies/izek:guard_set) or walked with her (join_with_her). Only while he lives and has been told the truth; Strahd's window scene has a way for him to take the window.

Izek gave Ireena the first doll Blinsky carved (allies/izek:sister_1), at her door, at Kolyan's grave or by the camp fire. The first of three scenes between the two; the camp talks (narrative/camp/izek.dialogue) play the same scenes when both travel with the party.
Ireena asked Izek what their parents were like, and he had very little to give (allies/izek:sister_2). The second of three scenes between the two.
Izek told Ireena the name he shouted through the trees, Viorela (allies/izek:sister_3), and she chose which name is hers (ireena_birth_name_kept). The third scene between the two.

Which name Ireena kept after Izek told her the one he shouted through the trees: ireena (Ireena only) or both (Ireena by day, the other when it is her brother who says it). Set by allies/izek:sister_3_a and sister_3_b; the finale and her epilogue may read it.
